claims.quote: In the Matter of: CITY OF THE DALLES, an Oregon municipal corporation, Plaintiff, vs. MICHAEL ROGOWAY and ADVANCE LOCAL MEDIA LLC (dba “Oregonian Media Group”) Defendants. | This Settlement Agreement (“Agreement”) is entered into this 13th day of December, 2022 | The City denied the Request. | 1.2 Disclosure of Historical Data. At any time prior to the Effective Date but no later than one day after the Effective Date of this Agreement, the City will disclose to ALM the total Annual Water Usage for each of the following calendar years: 2012 through 2021.
claims.derived: Years 2012 through 2021 as printed; agreement effective 12/13/2022.
